+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: Resolve partials from the document up to the layer root, and copy the partials of the plugin root into a snapshot
+---
+## Where the request came from
+
+The FoundationModelsAgents session asked for this card. It goes together with `^s8kdzy3` (the flat `agents/` folder).
+
+## Why
+
+In `swissarmyhammer/builtin`, `_partials/`, `agents/`, and `skills/` are siblings below one root, and a skill includes `_partials/step-record` against that root. The `../skills` marketplace put its partials in `skills/_partials/` by mistake. The snapshot writer got a rule to match it: `SnapshotRun.copyPartials(ofSkills:)` (`Sources/Marketplace/SnapshotWriter.swift`) copies the `_partials/` of each folder that holds a selected skill. Agents at `<plugin root>/agents/` cannot get those partials. The `../skills` repository will move `skills/_partials/` to `_partials/` at its root.
+
+Today the include search does not know where the document is:
+
+- `DotfolderLoader.partialPaths(for:)` (`Sources/FoundationModelsExtras/DotfolderLoader.swift`) looks only in each `partialLocations` entry at the layer root.
+- `StenciledDotfolderStack.render(_:in:)` takes the text and the layer, but not the path of the document.
+
+## What
+
+### 1. The include walk
+
+1. An `{% include "_partials/x" %}` in a document at `<layer root>/a/b/doc.md` searches these paths, nearest first: `a/b/_partials/x.md`, then `a/_partials/x.md`, then `_partials/x.md` at the layer root.
+2. Across layers, the highest layer that holds the partial wins, as today. Thus a partial next to a skill overrides the partial of the plugin, and a partial at the root serves the skills and the agents.
+3. `DotfolderLoader` walks the ancestor folders of the document, from the folder of the document to the layer root. At each level, it checks each `partialLocations` entry.
+4. `StenciledDotfolderStack` gets a render form that knows where the document is. Examples: `render(_:at:in:)`, which takes the path of the document relative to the layer root, or a form over the `Located` value that `FrontmatterDocumentStack` gives. Choose the shape during the work, and document it.
+5. The current `render(_:in:)` stays, and it searches the layer root only.
+6. The diagnostic for a partial that no layer holds lists each folder that the walk searched.
+7. The walk never goes above the layer root. The confinement checks of `DotfolderStack` apply at each level.
+
+### 2. The snapshot copy
+
+1. The partials of a catalog plugin are `<plugin source>/_partials/`. For a tree with no catalog, they are `<root>/_partials/`.
+2. The snapshot writer copies that folder to `<snapshot>/_partials/`.
+3. Remove the rule "the `_partials/` of the parent folder of each selected skill".
+4. When two plugins hold a partial with the same name, the later plugin wins, with one diagnostic, as for skills and agents.
+5. A `_partials/` folder inside a skill folder is copied with the skill folder, as today. The include walk then finds it at `<snapshot>/<skill>/_partials/`.
+
+## Effects on other work
+
+- The fixture `Tests/MarketplaceTests/Fixtures/catalogs/swissarmyhammer-agents/` holds its partials in `skills/_partials/`. Move them to `_partials/` at the fixture root, to match the new `../skills` layout.
+- FoundationModelsSkills reads marketplace layers. A marketplace that still holds `skills/_partials/` loses those partials from its snapshot after this change. Record that in the CHANGELOG.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] A skill at `<root>/commit/SKILL.md` and an agent at `<root>/agents/committer.md` both resolve `_partials/sah-x` to `<root>/_partials/sah-x.md`.
+- [ ] A partial at `<root>/commit/_partials/sah-x.md` wins for that skill only. The agent still gets `<root>/_partials/sah-x.md`.
+- [ ] Across layers, the highest layer that holds the partial wins.
+- [ ] `render(_:in:)` keeps its current behavior.
+- [ ] The diagnostic for a partial that is not found lists each folder that the walk searched.
+- [ ] A snapshot of a plugin with `_partials/` at its source root holds `<snapshot>/_partials/`.
+- [ ] A snapshot of a tree with no catalog holds the `_partials/` of the root.
+- [ ] Two plugins with a partial of the same name: the later plugin wins, with one diagnostic.
+- [ ] The "parent folder of each selected skill" rule is gone.
+- [ ] The new public API has documentation. The README, `plan.md`, and the CHANGELOG describe the walk and the new snapshot rule.
+- [ ] The Extras tests stay green.
+
+## Tests
+
+- [ ] A test proves that a skill and an agent below one root both resolve a partial at the root.
+- [ ] A test proves that a partial next to a skill wins for that skill only.
+- [ ] A test proves the order of the walk: the nearest folder first, the layer root last.
+- [ ] A test proves that the walk does not go above the layer root.
+- [ ] A test proves that the highest layer wins across layers.
+- [ ] A test proves the text of the diagnostic for a partial that is not found.
+- [ ] A test proves that a snapshot of a plugin copies `<plugin source>/_partials/` to `<snapshot>/_partials/`.
+- [ ] A test proves that a tree with no catalog copies `<root>/_partials/`.
+- [ ] A test proves that the later plugin wins for a partial with the same name, with one diagnostic.
+- [ ] The `swissarmyhammer-agents` fixture test proves that the layer holds `_partials/sah-*.md` from the fixture root.
+
+#marketplace #extras #cross-repo #partials
\ No newline at end of file
